coordinate_variables: bits 1..40 of x, then bits 0..40 of y
feature_family: constant, 81 linear Boolean variables, and all 3240 squarefree quadratic products
sample_law: uniform 40-bit value for bits 1..40 of x; reject x with no point on the curve; choose one of its two y values uniformly; reject repeated x and stop at 8192 accepted points or resource cap
stop_rule: Stop at coordinate feature rank 3322, 8192 accepted points, or cap. Compare with the frozen 3198 pair-sum rank; finite-sample deficits remain sample-specific unless proved symbolically.
claim_boundary: Rank control for random points of the same N41 curve with x low bit zero. It identifies how many of the 124 reproducible pair-sum quadratic dependencies are explained by the curve equation alone.
